post.originalText:
Is Muse Wonder full better than opus 5.5?

I gave them the same prompt 

goal is to build me a triple aaa level lawn mower simulator i can drink beer and smoke a cigar.

Api equivalent cost : 
muse - $4.11
opus - $99.43

It is very clear that muse is not anywhere near close to frontier in 3d tasks like video games, or even printable cad designs. 

Even scarier is it burned my $50 plan spending $4.11 in api equivalent tokens. 

wut?! 

i had to upgrade to $200 plan to finish this run.
